title: Red Sea crossing (yam suph) - location uncertain
summary: The sea Israel crossed on dry ground after leaving Egypt, camped "before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon" (Exod 14:2).
coordinate_basis: No coordinates: OpenBible.info gives 8 competing identifications (Gulf of Suez 40%, Bitter Lakes 35%, Lake Timsah 15%, Ballah Lakes, Gulf of Aqaba, Pelusiac Nile branch, Lake Manzala, Lake Bardawil each <10%). Related: Pi-hahiroth (openbible a/ababfd2), top identification only 25%.

certainty.basis: OpenBible.info "Red Sea 1" (Exod 13:18; 15:4): top identification Gulf of Suez at 40% (percent refers to that identification).

open_questions: Which crossing site to display (if any)? Kept null until the owner chooses; OpenBible Pi-hahiroth page: https://www.openbible.info/geo/ancient/ababfd2/pi-hahiroth
